title: You Think Pain Travels Straight Up One Wire, Yet Fast Touch Slams Your Spine Shut
description:
You think pain shoots up one straight alarm wire! Yet rubbing a bumped shin slams a spinal gate! This is the true story of Melzack and Wall's discovery. Here is what went wrong with old pain medicine.
